business_problem: St. Luke’s access centers tracked patient journeys across multiple calls and teams through manual processes, forcing employees to search disconnected systems instead of working from a centralized patient view.
solution_summary: St. Luke’s implemented Microsoft Dynamics 365 in its access centers to create a 360-degree patient view across calls, appointments, and referrals. The solution connects Epic electronic health records running on Azure into Dynamics 365, so access-center agents can see appointment history and update case, activity, and scheduling data without searching multiple systems. Twilio integrates caller data so patient records can surface automatically, while Power BI provides front-end dashboards for case tracking, referral conversion, and operational reporting. The architecture turns previously manual handoffs into a single workflow for phone agents, helping St. Luke’s simplify scheduling, reduce rekeying, and personalize each patient interaction.

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365
solution_components.role: Acts as the access-center CRM for case tracking, activity tracking, appointment management, and the 360-degree patient view.

solution_components.name: Epic
solution_components.role: Provides the electronic health record data that agents need to view and update during calls.

solution_components.name: Azure
solution_components.role: Hosts the Epic-connected integration layer that keeps health data available to the access-center solution.

solution_components.name: Power BI
solution_components.role: Delivers front-end analytics for case tracking, referral conversions, and operational reporting.

solution_components.name: Twilio customer engagement platform
solution_components.role: Uses caller information to present patient data automatically so agents can personalize each interaction.

data_flow: When a patient calls, Twilio helps identify the caller, Epic health-record data is surfaced through Azure-backed integration into Dynamics 365, agents update cases and appointments in the CRM, and Power BI dashboards track cases, referrals, and service performance.
business_outcome: St. Luke’s access-center staff can now see and act on a fuller patient context in one workflow, improving scheduling efficiency, referral handling, and the overall patient experience.
metrics: More than 300 locations in Pennsylvania and New Jersey
Access-center staffing planned to grow from 300 to 1,000 employees
architecture_clues: Real-time integration between Epic data and access centers
Caller recognition automatically presents patient data in Dynamics 365
Power BI powers the front-end analytics interface
evidence_quotes: St. Luke’s is modernizing this experience by connecting electronic health records from Epic to Microsoft Dynamics 365 and using other Microsoft tools to provide agents with better access to information.
St. Luke’s is implementing Dynamics 365 in access centers across its network for case tracking, activity tracking, and appointment management.
Access center computers can recognize a patient’s phone number and automatically present their data in Dynamics 365 so that employees can see appointment information without having to search.
